title: bzf project file
description: The project file `<Name>.bzfproj` that marks a project folder: a one-line JSON object at the top of the folder, whose file name is the project's name. Written when the project is created and again only when a copy becomes a project of its own. Every store format has `format` and `project`; this schema describes the rest for the store format bzf/1.x. A reader opens a project of a newer major format read-only, never refuses it and never rewrites it. A folder written under specification edition 0.1 has it as `<Name>.bzf`, and a reader takes either name; `.bzf` is now the extension of a project as one file (README, "A document, a file, a folder").

format.description: The store format: "bzf/" and the format's version, "bzf/1". A higher minor version only adds what a reader keeps without knowing it.

project.description: The project's id: random at creation, kept when the folder is moved, new when it is copied.

copiedFrom.description: The id of the project this one was copied from.
